entities.summary: Elna Camilla Odhnoff was a Swedish Social Democrat politician. She served as Minister without portfolio responsible for Family, Youth and Immigration in 1967–1974. She served as the Governor of Blekinge County in 1974–1992 and was the first female governor in Sweden. She was born in Gamlestaden, Gothenburg.
